scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “Ample rank-two bundles on the quadric surface without Griffiths-positive metrics” (preprints/ample-rank-two-bundles-on-the-quadric-surface-without-griffiths-positive-metrics-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 050 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 af1c052828ec0913), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is an algebraic vector bundle G of rank two on S such that, for every positive integer m, the bundle Em = f∗ mG ⊗ P is ample. There is an integer m0 such that Em admits no smooth Hermitian metric with strictly Griffiths-positive Chern curvature for every m ≥ m0.
